items.name: page-container
items.title: Page Container
items.description: The frame of a page: full width, responsive padding, and the spacing between its sections. Use it as the outermost element of every page. Preinstalled in the templates.
items.docs: Wrap each page in PageContainer. Content rendered inside another page, such as an inline child route or a tab panel, adds none of its own.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The heading of a page: its title, an optional description, and page-level actions. Use it once per page, inside PageContainer. Preinstalled in the templates.
items.docs: Render PageHeader once per page, as the first child of its PageContainer.

items.name: record-link
items.title: Record Link
items.description: A native router link for record names and identifiers in tables and lists: foreground text at rest, underline on hover and visible keyboard focus. Preinstalled in both application templates.
items.docs: Render inside a React Router and pass the record route through to. Carry the current list query in to.search when opening a child route. Supports native Link props and refs; use action buttons and menu items separately.

items.name: settings-dialog
items.title: Settings Dialog
items.description: A settings dialog after shadcn's sidebar-13: grouped categories in a sidebar on the left, the open one on the right, a scrolling row on a phone. Use it for account or application settings that open over the current page.
items.docs: Pass groups of { id, label, icon } items, the activeId and onSelect (or renderItem to draw each entry as a router link), and render the open entry as children, optionally in a SettingsDialogSection. Every word comes from the props; the component ships no locale keys.

items.name: route-dialog
items.title: Route Dialog
items.description: A child route presented as a centered modal dialog, opened and closed by its URL. Use it for create and edit forms. Preinstalled in the templates.
items.docs: Return RouteDialog from the component of a child route, and call useRouteOverlay() only from inside it. The close button is translated under routeOverlay.close; add it to your locale resources (Close, 关闭), or it reads Close in every language.

items.name: route-drawer
items.title: Route Drawer
items.description: A child route presented as a modal panel at the right edge, opened and closed by its URL. Use it for a record's details. Preinstalled in the templates.
items.docs: Return RouteDrawer from the component of a child route, and call useRouteOverlay() only from inside it. The close button is translated under routeOverlay.close; add it to your locale resources (Close, 关闭), or it reads Close in every language.

items.name: route-child-page
items.title: Route Child Page
items.description: A child route presented as a non-modal page covering the content area, keeping the page beneath mounted. Use it for a drill-down that needs the whole content area. Preinstalled in the templates.
items.docs: Return RouteChildPage from the component of a child route. It covers the nearest positioned ancestor, so render a page's own outlet beside its container rather than inside it. A child page that can only render inside another one, such as the child page of a tab, covers that one whole.

items.name: kanban
items.title: Kanban
items.description: A generic board: columns of cards dragged within and between columns, reporting each move through a callback. Use it for any board view, such as issues by status from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects.
items.docs: Adapted from the Kibo UI kanban (MIT). Compose KanbanProvider, KanbanBoard, KanbanHeader, KanbanCards and KanbanCard; apply each onMove to your items and pass them back. Pass labels to translate the screen reader announcements.

items.name: property-fields
items.title: Property Fields
items.description: The fields of a record's property card: the titled card, label and value rows, a select, chips with creation, a date, a number, a line of text, a long text, a link, a person as a value, and a row of avatars. Use it for the side column of a detail page. PropertyCard draws its fields one of two ways: variant form shows every value in its control, and variant inline reads first, each value plain text that a double-click, Enter or F2 edits, shaded under the pointer, with a copy button on hover; a long text opens whole on a click, and a link, which a click opens, is edited from a pencil.
items.docs: Values in, changes out: each field reports a change through onChange. Pass PropertyFieldLabels built from your locale resources for the words the fields show themselves. Set variant='inline' on PropertyCard for the read-first card, and give each field an aria-label, its name while it shows as text.

items.name: rich-text-editor
items.title: Rich Text Editor
items.description: A Markdown-in, Markdown-out rich text editor on official Tiptap extensions, with a composable toolbar, @mentions from an async search, pasted or dropped uploads, and room for your own extensions. Use it for descriptions and comments; store uploads through @nocobase/app-plugin-file.
items.docs: Give value and onChange (Markdown). onMentionSearch answers candidates for @query; mentions are stored as [@Name](mention://<kind>/<id>). onUpload stores a pasted or dropped file and answers its URL. extensions adds to or overrides richTextExtensions(); toolbar takes a render function, and RichTextToolbar, RichTextToolbarButton, RichTextInlineTools and RichTextBlockTools compose your own. Every word comes from labels, English by default.

items.name: markdown-view
items.title: Markdown View
items.description: Markdown rendered as compact prose for descriptions and comments, with mention chips and fenced code a consumer may draw itself. Use it to display what rich-text-editor writes.
items.docs: Pass the Markdown as content. renderCodeBlock draws a fenced block itself, such as a mermaid diagram; mentionIcon picks a mention chip's icon by its kind. remarkCjkAutolink ends a bare URL at CJK text or full-width punctuation; add it after remark-gfm wherever else you render the same Markdown.

items.name: long-text
items.title: Long Text
items.description: A long text shown in part, the last line fading out instead of an ellipsis. LongText is for where there is room, such as the description under a page's title or a comment: five lines that unfold in place on a click. LongTextPreview is for a narrow column, such as a record's introduction or address beside its page: three muted lines whose whole text opens in a pop-up, so the column never grows. Neither reacts unless the text overflows.
items.docs: Pass the text as children; a string keeps its line breaks, and rendered content such as MarkdownView works too. LongTextPreview needs a label, the heading of the pop-up that shows the text whole.

items.name: comment-thread
items.title: Comment Thread
items.description: A record's activity line: comment threads with reactions, reply, edit, delete and resolve, the consumer's own entries between them, and a composer with modes and files. Use it for a record's discussion, such as an issue's comments from @nocobase/app-plugin-projects.
items.docs: Map your comments to CommentItem and threads to CommentThreadItem, oldest first, and put your own entries between them as custom entries (TimelineActivity draws a change). Every action is a callback that answers a promise; renderMarkdown draws the text (markdown-view suits it). Every word comes from labels, English by default.

items.name: attachment-list
items.title: Attachment List
items.description: Files on a record or a message: image thumbnails and file chips with download, the files waiting to be sent, and a section that takes uploads. Use it to show and add files stored through @nocobase/app-plugin-file.
items.docs: Map your files to AttachmentFile. onPreview opens your own preview for every file; without it images open in the item's dialog and other files download. AttachmentPanel takes uploads through onUpload and confirms removals before calling onRemove. Every word comes from labels, English by default.

items.name: flow-diagram
items.title: Flow Diagram
items.description: Read-only React Flow canvas with ELK orthogonal routing for directed graphs, including branches, cycles, parallel edges and self-loops. Use for interactive process views; pass nodes, edges and detail callbacks.
items.docs: Pass nodes and edges with unique ids, an ariaLabel and either a bounded canvas height or autoHeight. Use direction DOWN with autoHeight for detailed page diagrams; height follows the full layout including outer routes and labels. The default node is 232×104 canvas units; set width/height for richer renderNode content. direction is RIGHT or DOWN. nodeDescription and nodeActions add supporting summaries and configuration controls. For bounded canvases, initialMinZoom=0.8 preserves initial readability and showMiniMap provides overview navigation; Fit still shows the whole graph. Translate flowDiagram.overview when using the minimap. onNodeClick/onEdgeClick open your details; onLayoutError reports invalid graph or layout failures. Translate flowDiagram.empty, loading, failed, nodeHelp and edgeHelp; see the components README. Includes React Flow CSS. Uses application primary/card/foreground/border tokens in light and dark themes. Ordinary edges are subdued, solid and labeled directly on the route. Set visited on nodes/edges for actual history and highlighted for the current node or available edges; current nodes have a stronger fill and ring. ELK optimizes port order to reduce crossings. Decorative nodes/edges are not focusable or selectable.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Standard TanStack Table v8 table with controlled server pagination and sorting, selection and column visibility.
items.docs: Use DataTable with typed columns and getRowId. Server data must use manualPagination and manualSorting with controlled state; never sort or paginate only a fetched page locally. pagination=false renders every supplied row and leaves pagination to the caller.

items.name: setup-readiness
items.title: Setup Readiness
items.description: Contextual prerequisite checks for a feature, with missing, ready and unavailable states. Connect real authorized business reads; never infer readiness from installed plugins. Preinstalled in application templates.
items.docs: Memoize SetupCheck descriptors and the async inspect callback; wire useSetupReadiness to the feature’s authorized aggregate read and pass its state to SetupReadiness. Supply translated labels, stable ids and authorized configuration links. No checks or disabled inspection causes no reads. Refresh on the host route key and after configuration saves; focus rechecks mounted checks. Unknown reason is unavailable, signIn, forbidden or invalid. Only missing checks render configuration links; denied/invalid reads are not missing. Initial all-ready hides; explicit refresh keeps a compact confirmation and the refresh control. This is informational; execution still validates prerequisites server-side. Templates also include RequiredRoleSetup for explicitly declared business roles.

items.name: feedback-form
items.title: Feedback Form
items.description: Preserves form input, maps safe field errors and focuses the first editable error in layout order. Preinstalled in the templates.
items.docs: Show mapped reasons only beside fields/groups, with automatic reveal/focus and no top summary or navigation list. Unmapped failures or unavailable focus targets keep a safe accessible form message. Use submitted names or data-field-path; return promises or pass caught errors via error. RHF consumers pass submitting and validationErrors. Register persistent FormFeedback descriptors for unmounted regions and stable rows. Add formFeedback.field, invalid, failed, network and denied to application translations; device-approval includes them in its locales. Reconcile copied source as well as the runtime when upgrading. Publication is gated by check-form-feedback-release.mjs: the declared app-client version floor must be obtainable and export the form APIs in JavaScript and declarations. Release the runtime and raise this item's floor before publishing the registry. Existing controlled fields expose trusted errors through aria-errormessage or explicitly associated data-slot=field-error / data-feedback-field-error nodes.
